title: What is a directory?
question: A directory is names, each pointing to a file. What happens when one is made, and when one is listed? (In memory: ramfs.)
text: Call 1, [mkdirat(AT_FDCWD, "/sub", 0755)](1): [ramfs_mkdir](1:ramfs_mkdir) A new directory: an inode like a file's, and a name for it in /.

Call 3, [getdents64(fd, [256], 256)](3): [dcache_readdir](3:dcache_readdir) Listing: an in-memory directory's names are the dentry cache itself; walk its children... [filldir64](3:filldir64) ...each copied out to the program: its name, its inode, its type.
